summary: Implemented an evidence-only Steward Presence and Recall State Machine with explicit transition validation, local recall artifact ingestion, JSON and Markdown report generation, CLI access, Operations Center status-bar surfacing, and tests for valid transitions, invalid transitions, missing evidence, unknown state, recall requested, recall acknowledged, resumed operation, and output generation.
known_limitations: The state machine is evidence-only and reports unknown when approved local artifacts do not establish presence or recall state.
It does not notify the Steward, acknowledge recalls, implement mobile app behavior, or track the Steward outside Estate-approved local signals.
runtime/steward/steward_presence_state.json is generated by the CLI but remains ignored by repository runtime ignore rules.
